evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Frames operational safety and capability through verification and practice, appealing to reliability/security (conservation) and verified operational mastery (competence).

mints.name: PracticeAsTrueCapability
mints.title: unrehearsed safeguards are not actually possessed
mints.frame: Does the speaker evaluate preparedness by demanding demonstrated practice rather than theoretical capability?
